# MyGo component support

<!-- Generated by tooling/generate_mygo_schema.py; edit capabilities.json. -->

Desktop MyGo; Native OCaml rendering and MyGo browser hosting excluded.

This inventory records implementation routes and behavioral test references. It does not establish live desktop qualification; see the host table below. Per-kind hashes bind reviewed behavior to the canonical OCaml contracts. Feature exceptions apply only to the specified values, never to an entire component.
